notes: Original per-slot Root/Root_model/model (1) additive overlay; original meshes, UVs and colors are deduplicated by content.
Local transforms are exact, not forced to a common scale or rotation. Follow animated Root and Root_model ancestors from board-motion.json.
matrixInNormalPrefab includes Root Y45, excludes NormalChessboard_01 root scale0.9; same space as grid-hooks.json.
m_IsActive and material._Color.r/g/b/a are animated by the source clips. Use board-motion clips floatCurves for exact times.
Shader SFX/Mesh_Additive uses Blend SrcAlpha One, Cull Off, ZTest LEqual, ZWrite Off. Material serialized _ZWrite=1 is unused by this shader.
Shader vertex output color = vertexColor * _Color * 2. Fragment rgb = MainTex.rgb * color.rgb; alpha = MainTex.a * color.a * MaskTex.r * _FGUIAlpha. No model lighting.
Renderer material list is preserved exactly, including duplicates. Match submesh to material index; only repeat the last submesh if there are more materials than submeshes, as Unity does.
